FASSTO launches an AMR subscription with orchestration and maintenance

The package combines FX100 or BX100 robots with FASSTO Brain to reduce upfront warehouse investment.

Robot Newspaper ↗27 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

Hardware and service in a monthly package

FASSTO Robotics introduced an AMR subscription with its FASSTO Brain warehouse execution system. Installation, configuration, training, maintenance and cloud updates are included, while outright purchase remains available. Monthly rates are undisclosed, preventing a payback calculation from the announcement alone.

Matching the warehouse workflow

FX100 supports different picking carts, including existing carts. BX100 is described as suitable for 75-centimeter aisles. FASSTO offers deployment without mandatory proofs of concept or rack rebuilding and cites about one month for setup, subject to suitability at each warehouse.

Site results are not universal guarantees

FASSTO cites its Yongin Mega Smart logistics center, using AMRs since 2022, with worker travel below half and throughput tripled. These are company-reported results at its own site, not independent measurements or guaranteed outcomes for every warehouse.
